TV setup guide
On your TV
Home → Apps
Newer TV? Open App Settings inside Apps.\nOlder remote? Home may be called Smart Hub.
Press on your remote
Press 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 in order.

No number keys? Press 123 on the remote to open the on-screen number pad. Use the direction and select buttons to enter 1 → 2 → 3 → 4 → 5 in order, without long pauses. If colored buttons appear first, switch to the number pad.
In the menu that opens
Developer Mode → ON
Host PC IP · Enter this phone address
Confirm with OK on your TV.
Connect to the same network as your TV
Restart your TV
Save with OK, then hold the remote power button until the TV turns off and starts again. After restart, return here and tap Find my TV.
Unplug the TV for 10–15 seconds, then reconnect it.
Host PC IP means this phone in this installer. Keep this address, not 127.0.0.1. If the phone IP changes, update it on the TV and restart.

This is an experimental installer. Compatibility depends on your TV and the app you choose.\n\nSigning keys stay encrypted on this phone. Do not uninstall this installer or clear its data: you need those keys to update your TV apps.
